scope: Documentation-only assessment; no runtime suites rerun

tools/a2rail/mcpserver.py.stdout:
usage: mcpserver.py [-h] (--socket SOCKET | --exe EXE) [--out-dir OUT_DIR |
                    --out-root OUT_ROOT] [--artifact-root ARTIFACT_ROOT]
                    [--platform PLATFORM | --config CONFIG] [--seed SEED]
                    [--rail NAME=VALUE]

Small stdio MCP tool server backed by the emulator's native tool registry. No
shell, expression evaluation, implicit pause, mutation retry or HTTP server.
An attached session remains alive on EOF; a launched session is owned and
closed.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --socket SOCKET
  --exe EXE
  --out-dir OUT_DIR
  --out-root OUT_ROOT
  --artifact-root ARTIFACT_ROOT
                        explicit existing root for artifact access; managed
                        launch defaults to its fresh output directory
  --platform PLATFORM
  --config CONFIG
  --seed SEED
  --rail NAME=VALUE

tools/a2rail/experiment.py.stdout:
usage: experiment.py [-h] {run,compare} ...

Build/run a declared raw CPU fixture and retain context-bound efficiency
evidence. An additive Rosetta companion, not a new Rosetta v3 CLI feature.
Build tools are explicit executable/argv lists; no shell. Each invocation owns
a fresh directory and a fresh machine. A raw load is never a GS/OS boot claim.

positional arguments:
  {run,compare}

options:
  -h, --help     show this help message and exit
